pages.text: Honey can be fermented into mead, a sweet drink with a useful health boost.$(br2)Start by making Mead Must in the Brew Kettle.
Add water and honeycomb to a heated Brew Kettle. Growthcraft honey comb creates a small batch of Mead Must. Vanilla honeycomb creates a larger batch.
Move Mead Must into a Fermentation Barrel and add Bayanus Yeast.$(br2)Each bucket of Mead Must needs one yeast. After fermentation, bottle the mead with a glass bottle or wine bottle.
